title: Line Spreads That Produce Projective Planes
content: We classify in an explicit way those line spreads of projective 5-space over a field that have the property that the given spread induces a spread in the 3-space generated by any pair of spread lines. We determine their fix groups and conclude that there exist such spreads with trivial fix group.  Also, we characterise regular line spreads among all line spreads of projective 3-space by their projectivity group, and also by a weakening of the regularity condition.
